newsitem.title: USA: New York 'Fame' student dies on prom night.
newsitem.headline: New York 'Fame' student dies on prom night.

text.p: A student from New York's "Fame" school celebrating senior prom night on a cruise ship died after falling or jumping into the East River early on Saturday, police said.
A crewman from 'The Spirit of New York' jumped into the murky water after the student from LaGuardia High School in midtown Manhattan, but could not find him.

LaGuardia High School, formerly New York City High School for Performing Arts, is a special school for musicians, artists and actors. The 1980 movie "Fame" and television series was based on the school programme.
The teenage student, who has not been identified, was getting off the boat shortly after 5 a.m. EDT (0900 GMT) at the South Street Seaport as the boat was docking at the pier.
"A crew member jumped in after him but couldn't locate the young man," police said.

A police spokeswoman said it was not known whether he jumped or fell in, but witnesses reported hearing him call for help. Police said he was missing, presumed dead, and scuba divers were searching for the body.
The seaport, a popular tourist attraction, is in the Wall Street area of lower Manhattan.
